topic: shared-integrity snapshot preflight for offline/local public TinyLlama trace capture

sources.fact: Offline/firewalled Transformers use requires downloaded/cached files ahead of time; HF_HUB_OFFLINE and local_files_only control offline loading.
hf_hub_download uses a version-aware cache, and snapshot_download downloads an entire repository at a specified revision with allow_patterns/ignore_patterns filtering.
The TinyLlama tree lists the required model/tokenizer/config files and their published sizes, including config.json at 608 bytes and model.safetensors at 2.2 GB.

decision_pressure: The env preflight must not use a weaker snapshot definition than materializer/capture digest checks.
change_made: public_trace_env_preflight.py now calls the shared import-light hf_snapshot_integrity inspector and reports found_complete_integrity_snapshot.
